structured_output.what_is_happening: Around 07:26 UTC at least 10 Solana tokens named "Kardashev Research" / $KARDASHEV were launched within about 25 minutes. They appear to point at a post by Beff Jezos (Guillaume Verdon, e/acc founder, Extropic CEO) whose URL, x.com/beffjezos/status/2103746282699534606, sits in this token's metadata. I could not read the post (X returned HTTP 402). This token (2z8d…) was created about 12 minutes before detection, reportedly on a Meteora virtual curve that graduated in the same second, and now trades on PumpSwap. Its "website" field links to a usepaid.app page for a different token, 5wW9…, which launched about 13 minutes earlier and has done about $1.0M in 1-hour volume compared with $232k here. So this looks like a copycat of the clone that is leading. Price is down 30% in the last 5 minutes after a +180% spike, and 5-minute unique buyers dropped from about 2,028 (15-minute window) to 193.
